node_types.label: SourceDocument
node_types.description: Stable source identity from existing doc_id; created by code

node_types.label: DocumentVersion
node_types.description: Source content edition; dates and currency may remain unknown

node_types.label: Chunk
node_types.description: Original prepared text and legacy chunk_id; created by code

node_types.label: Entity
node_types.description: Named domain entity; kind and scope are part of identity

node_types.label: Offering
node_types.description: Scholarship opening scoped by explicit year, round and degree

node_types.label: Fact
node_types.description: Evidence-backed fact or textual rule; no executable condition tree

relationship_types.label: HAS_VERSION
relationship_types.description: Source document has a content edition

relationship_types.label: HAS_CHUNK
relationship_types.description: Edition contains the original prepared chunk

relationship_types.label: NEXT_CHUNK
relationship_types.description: Original adjacency only; do not bridge omitted chunks

relationship_types.label: MENTIONED_IN
relationship_types.description: Identity and scope are supported by this chunk

relationship_types.label: SUPPORTED_BY
relationship_types.description: Fact cites an exact source quote

relationship_types.label: ABOUT
relationship_types.description: Fact concerns this explicitly scoped subject

relationship_types.label: HAS_OFFERING
relationship_types.description: A scholarship entity has a scoped offering

relationship_types.label: HAS_TRACK
relationship_types.description: Offering has a scholarship track, not a study-language track

relationship_types.label: RELATED_TO
relationship_types.description: Evidence-backed retrieval connection, never an unconditional eligibility claim
